messages:
Alex: Heads-up — final cut window is scheduled for Wed Mar 3 22:00 UTC. Quick check: who can staff the rollout and who will own the canary shards? Proposing a 30m go/no-go sync at 21:30 UTC. RSVP with :thumbsup: (attend + canary), :eyes: (standby), or :x: (unavailable). Calendar invite: <https://calendar.company.com/event/abcd1234>

Maya: :thumbsup: I can take Canary A (search-model).

Tom: :thumbsup: I can be on-call for infra and take Canary B. Prefer to be paged for any KV cache/latency regressions.

Li: :eyes: I’m OOO until 23:00 UTC but can help with rollback steps if needed after 22:30. Put me as rollback contact.

Sarah: :thumbsup: Can add DB migration pre-check and run the network egress smoke test. Also suggest adding a quick post-cut validation for embeddings quality.

Alex: Great — thanks. Draft agenda below (short):
```
21:00 — automated smoke-run results posted (deploy-bot)
21:15 — quick infra health/obs check (metrics + SLOs)
21:30 — go/no-go decision (30m)
21:55 — cut begins (handoff: canary owners start rollout)
22:05 — post-cut quick validations (traffic, latency, top error types)
22:30 — rollback decision window closes / escalate as needed
```

Alex: Checklist (copy for the meeting notes):
- Owners confirmed for Canary A/B
- Rollback contact listed (Li)
- DB migration dry-run ✅
- Smoke-run job scheduled at 21:00 ✅
- Post-cut validation set added (:eyes: Sarah)

deploy-bot: Scheduled smoke-run job for release-2026-03-03 at 21:00 UTC. Job ID: smoke-2001. Results will be posted to this thread when complete.

Tom: Quick note — bringing a tiny change to autoscaler thresholds. If the canary shows CPU spike > 85%, we should cut the roll and revert.

Maya: Also pinging security for the new env var access — @sarah can you confirm the secrets rotation has been tested?

Sarah: Confirmed — secrets rotation tested on staging. I'll post the short checklist in the calendar invite.

Alex: Last ask — can each owner paste a single-line contact (Slack + phone) before EOD? I'll update the roster and post final attendee list tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone. :pray:
